edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses
edges.quote: The neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses (NCLs) are a group of inherited neurodegenerative lysosomal storage disorders (LSDs)

edges.subject: NCL mutations
edges.quote: NCL mutations have far-ranging effects on cellular functions including autophagy and synaptic dysfunction.

edges.subject: TFEB
edges.quote: The discovery of the machinery controlling endo-lysosomal function via transcription factor EB (TFEB) and mTORC1, have also shed light on potential mechanisms by which NCL mutations may exert their effect.
